expert.description:
{Expert Weakness (H5)}

Reduces the damage of the selected enemy unit. Duration depends on Spell Power.

Each attack of the stack deals damage between min and “max - 100% x (max - min)”, lasts 1 x Spell Power rounds (rounded, at least 1)
Expert: affects all enemy stacks.

{Expert Slow (H5)}

Reduces the number of actions the selected enemy takes in battle.

Speed -40%, lasts 1 x Spell Power rounds (rounded, at least 1)
Expert: affects all enemy stacks.

{Expert Disrupting Ray (H5)}

Destroys the enemy's armor, lowering the target's Defense. Can be used repeatedly on the same target, but cannot reduce its Defense below 0.

Defense -6 (stacks, cannot be dispelled), lasts Spell Power rounds
Expert: affects all enemy stacks.

{Expert Decay (H5)}

Infects the enemy creature with plague, so it takes Earth damage every time it acts (no effect on undead, elemental and mechanical units).

The target takes 32 + 8 x Spell Power Earth damage after each action, lasts 5 rounds; no effect on undead, elemental and mechanical creatures
Expert: affects all enemy stacks.

{Expert Suffering (H5)}

Reduces the Attack of the selected enemy unit.

Attack -12, lasts 1 x Spell Power rounds (rounded, at least 1)
Expert: affects all enemy stacks.

{Expert Confusion (H5)}

Makes the selected enemy forget its duties on the battlefield. Some of the affected creatures forget to shoot or retaliate (no effect on undead, elemental and mechanical units).

100% of the creatures forget to shoot and retaliate (shooting and retaliation damage reduced proportionally), lasts 1 x Spell Power rounds (rounded, at least 1)
Expert: affects all enemy stacks.

{Expert Divine Strength (H5)}

Increases the damage of the selected unit (friendly units only). Duration depends on Spell Power.

Each attack of the stack deals damage between “min + 100% x (max - min)” and max, lasts 1 x Spell Power rounds (rounded, at least 1)
Expert: affects all friendly stacks.

{Expert Haste (H5)}

Makes the selected unit more active in battle.

Speed +40%, lasts 1 x Spell Power rounds (rounded, at least 1)
Expert: affects all friendly stacks.

{Expert Endurance (H5)}

Increases the Defense of the selected friendly unit. Duration depends on Spell Power.

Defense +12, lasts 1 x Spell Power rounds (rounded, at least 1)
Expert: affects all friendly stacks.

{Expert Cleansing (H5)}

Removes beneficial spells from enemy creatures and negative spells from friendly units. The caster's magic level greatly affects the result; low-level casters have little chance of dispelling the spells of high-level mages.

Dispels beneficial spells from enemy stacks and negative spells from friendly stacks; 100% success chance per spell
Expert: affects all stacks on the battlefield.

{Expert Righteous Might (H5)}

The affected creature becomes furious and bloodthirsty, greatly increasing its Attack.

Attack +12, lasts 1 x Spell Power rounds (rounded, at least 1)
Expert: affects all friendly stacks.

{Expert Deflect Missile (H5)}

Reduces the ranged damage taken by the selected friendly unit.

Ranged damage taken -70%, lasts 1 x Spell Power rounds (rounded, at least 1)
Expert: affects all friendly stacks.
